The Timeline

A journey through the milestones that built modern artificial intelligence.

1950 · Milestone 1 of 8

The Turing Test

Alan Turing asks 'Can machines think?' in Computing Machinery and Intelligence.

1956 · Milestone 2 of 8

Birth of AI

The Dartmouth Workshop convenes — AI is born as a field of study.

1997 · Milestone 3 of 8

Deep Blue

IBM's Deep Blue defeats world chess champion Garry Kasparov.

2012 · Milestone 4 of 8

ImageNet Revolution

AlexNet launches the era of deep learning with convolutional networks.

2017 · Milestone 5 of 8

Attention is All You Need

The Transformer architecture is introduced, enabling modern LLMs.

2022 · Milestone 6 of 8

ChatGPT Goes Viral

OpenAI releases ChatGPT, bringing conversational AI to the masses.

2024 · Milestone 7 of 8

Multimodal Era

Vision + language models redefine what AI systems can understand.

2025 · Milestone 8 of 8

Agentic AI

AI agents begin performing complex, multi-step tasks autonomously.
